ben: Quick sync: need to finalize acceptance gates for Optimize toolkit pilot (batching/caching/quant + eval alerts).

carla: Proposed gates: p99 latency reg <=10%, median cost/unit >=10% improvement, concordance loss <=4% on golden set, eval-alert FPR <=7%.

alice: Add per-tenant presets + dry-run SDK flag so customers can preview recs without applying them. Also audit logs for overrides.

derek: Ops: staged rollout + auto-rollback rules (error rate >0.5% or concordance drop CI >3%). Dashboards must show per-tenant concordance CI and sampled failures.

eva: QA: curate golden set (SE prompts + anonymized prod samples + tenant vignettes), run synthetic spike tests, and concordance pipeline daily. Pilot = 4 tenants, 2-week validation.
